name: Dusit Thani Public Company Limited
summary: Dusit Thani Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, owns and operates hotels and resorts in Thailand and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Hotel and Hotel Management, Education, Food, Real Estate Development, and Others. The company operates hotels and resorts under the Dusit Thani, dusitD2, Dusit Princess, Dusit Suites, ASAI, Elite Havens, and Devarana Dusit brand names; spas under the Devarana Wellness and Namm Spa brands; other businesses under the DREIT, Dusit Hospitality Services, and Baan Dusit Thani names; and healthy food restaurants.
